cases.name: War of the Five Kings: first-season armed conflict
cases.outcome: Armed conflict between the Stark-led northern/Riverlands coalition and the Lannister-controlled crown is active by the end of season 1.
cases.scope_revision: Retains version 1's armed-conflict outcome but removes its subsidiary clause about wider royal claims documented through S2E4. The richer acquired transcript corpus ends at S1E10. This endpoint clarification was made during development, before model construction or test inference, and supplies no causal variable or mechanism.
